<quote by="Proposed: Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza, Senator for the Madruga, Seconded: Garviel i Abrira i Erigo, Senator for Feroz">To add the Red Wind Wharfs to the Municipal Docks at Calvos

==Overview==
* Adds an [[edifice]] to the [[Construct Municipal Docks|Municipal Docks]] in Calvos Sound, Madruga
* Passed
* More information can be found in the '''[[Mermaids_in_the_basement#The_Red_Wind_Wharfs|Mermaids in the basement]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Summer 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 5 wains of mithril
* 15 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Red_Wind_Wharfs}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the wharfs will have the following effects: 
* Allows any army with the Forayer quality to move normally between Free Landing and the mainland, ignoring the island quality
* Increases the upkeep of the wharfs by one throne
